poem.title: 静夜思
poem.author: 李白
poem.text: 床前明月光，疑是地上霜。举头望明月，低头思故乡。

user_prompt:
Translate this poem into literary English.
Title: 静夜思
Author: 李白
Genre: 五言绝句
Source:
床前明月光，疑是地上霜。举头望明月，低头思故乡。
translation:
**Quiet Night Thoughts**

Before my bed, the moonlight gleams;
I wonder if it is frost upon the ground.
I raise my head to gaze at the bright moon,
Then lower it, thinking of my home.

床前明月光: Before my bed, the moonlight shines bright (or bright moonlight). 疑是地上霜: I wonder if it is frost on the ground. 举头望明月: I raise my head and gaze at the bright moon; 低头思故乡: lower it and think of home / my homeland. No additions. I can title "Thoughts on a Quiet Night" and four lines:
Before my bed, the moonlight gleams;
I wonder if it is frost upon the ground.
I lift my head to gaze at the bright moon,
Then bow it, thinking of my home.

"Then" not unsupported? Sequential implied. Fine. "I wonder if" 疑是 could be "I take it for frost on the ground" or "It seems like frost upon the ground." Li Bai famous. Perhaps title "Quiet Night Thoughts". Use "Beside my bed" vs 床前 before my bed. Traditional translation: "Before my bed a pool of light— / I wonder if it's frost aground. / Looking up, I find the moon bright; / Bowing, in homesickness I'm drowned." But avoid additions drowned. My clear version:
Before my bed, the bright moon shines;
I wonder if it is frost upon the ground.
I raise my head to gaze at the luminous moon,
Then lower it, thinking of my homeland.
Repetition moon needed complete? First 明月光 bright moonlight. Third 明月 bright moon. "glows" etc.

Before my bed, the moonlight shines so bright
I wonder if it is frost upon the ground.

Then bow it, lost in thoughts of home.

I wonder if it is frost upon the ground.
I raise my head and gaze at the bright moon,
